entities.summary: Jesús Marcelo Sucre Medina is a Venezuelan professional baseball catcher for the Delfines de La Guaira of the Venezuelan Major League. He previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Seattle Mariners, Tampa Bay Rays, and Baltimore Orioles.
